messages:
Alyssa: Kickoff — Cloudsmith marketplace + SI integration EAP. Goal: get HW preview into private marketplace listing, run benchmark suite, and agree NDA + joint announcement windows. Who can own the ops schedule?

Benji: I can own the ops schedule. Quick Q: do we have an NDA signed with Cloudsmith legal, or is that still pending?

Kevin (Cloudsmith): Partner update: our legal sent the template last week. Still need Redwood sig + one clause tweak about retention. I tagged our counsel @kevin.

Maria: For benchmarks, suggested targets: p99 latency under 200ms for 512 tokens, throughput >= 60 req/s on the 8xA100 config, and memory < 40GB for single-replica. Also we'll need raw perf logs + token-level traces for regressions.

Priya: For marketplace packaging: do we publish a Marketplace VM + container or an operator bundle? Azure/GC/Marketplace teams usually prefer operator bundles for private offers. Who'll assemble the package?

Benji: I'll coordinate packaging with Eng-Platform. Need a list of artifacts from Cloudsmith: container images (sha), helm chart, and a short runbook. Kevin — can you provide those?

Kevin (Cloudsmith): Yes. I'll upload images to partner registry and share SHA list. Also we have a small installer script we can include. ETA EOW.

Maria: Also proposing an evaluation harness: 3 workloads — latency-sensitive chat, long-seq generation, and batch-embed heavy. We'll run redwood/eval-suite v2 with these presets. I'll drop the prompt sets in the shared drive.

Alyssa: Good. Can we map responsibilities? Benji = ops schedule & packaging; Maria = benchmark plan & eval harness; Priya = marketplace packaging policy + listing; Kevin = partner artifacts + legal follow-up. I'll own announcement timeline & PR coordination.

Benji: Timeline draft: Week 0 (this week) — NDA sign + artifact handoff. Week 1 — packaging + test deploy in partner VPC. Week 2 — perf runs + telemetry collection. Week 3 — quality signoff + canary. Week 4 — private marketplace listing live + joint announcement window. Thoughts?

Kevin (Cloudsmith): Looks good. Legal will push NDA signature by EOD Thu. We might need one extra day for images to propagate to partner registry.

Priya: Marketplace checklist (short):
```
- partner-signed-nda: yes
- container-sha-list: received
- helm-chart: validated
- runbook: 1pg quickstart
- security-scan: pass
- billing-metadata: provided
- support-contact: cloudsmith-ops@cloudsmith.io
```

deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace/eap-checklists/cloudsmith - added Benji, Maria, Priya as owners.

Maria: One risk: quantization/accuracy regression on reduced-precision builds on their HW. We'll need evaluation thresholds and automated regression alerts tied to the eval harness. I'll configure alert hooks.

Alyssa: Noted. Maria, add the specific metric thresholds to the checklist. Kevin, can Cloudsmith run a preflight on accuracy sensitivity to int8/4-bit variants?

Kevin (Cloudsmith): Yes, we can run a sensitivity matrix. We'll share results as CSV and a short writeup.

Benji: Action items recap: 1) Benji — ops schedule + packaging timeline. 2) Maria — benchmark plan + alert thresholds. 3) Priya — packaging policy + marketplace metadata schema. 4) Kevin — artifacts + NDA follow-up + sensitivity mat. 5) Alyssa — announcement calendar + PR draft. I'll update the shared board after this thread. :thumbsup:

Alyssa: Thanks all — next sync Thu 11am PT. If NDA comes through earlier we can accelerate.
file_notes: EAP coordination thread for Cloudsmith marketplace + SI hardware partner; includes ops timeline, NDA status, packaging checklist, benchmark targets, and responsibilities.
